description:
Have you ever wondered why trophies are so boring? We have and now we've made them EPIC.

TrophySmack has changed the game when it comes to custom awards and sports trophies. Our groundbreaking design tool enables anyone to design or upload their very own custom masterpiece and pair it with chromed-out, metal hardware. From football to soccer and even golf, we have trophies for every occasion.

Our winning product collection drives thousands of users to our website every day, where we've celebrated with more than 10,000 customers since 2018. Although our primary focus started with fantasy football, it has become so much more. We've created custom hardware designs around everything from superheroes to company logos, and even some concepts built to shame the losers.

We're entrepreneurs, just like you, except we were featured on Shark Tank and now Mark Cuban is on board. Are you ready to grow your own brand of greatness and earn BIG? We'll give you the tools to succeed and help you to shine like the champion you are.  

Apply today!

 

*Other Terms and Conditions apply to Coupon Sites*
term_and_condition:
Welcome to TrophySmack! Thanks for applying to our Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals ("Affiliate", "you") who are accessing or using the Affiliate Program to refer customers to  TrophySmack ("us", "we") to purchase products or services from us.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Affiliate Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of the Application

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole and absolute discretion. Our Affiliate Program is designed to reward individuals that use social media platforms and podcasts to actively promote TrophySmack products. Affiliates whose discount or coupon codes are found in PPC campaigns or on websites that make them available to the general public may be removed from the program. 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

A unique Affiliate referral link is generated automatically for the applicant once the application is approved. If a customer clicks through your Affiliate referral link, then later clicks through using a different Affiliate's referral link, the last used Affiliate link receives the Affiliate commission.  

3. Commissions and Payments

As you send traffic to our website via your Affiliate referral link, you will receive commission for each unique purchase. Your progress for each referral will be reflected in real-time on your Affiliate dashboard.

Since we can't track your sales and traffic without you posting the full URL of your referral link, please be sure to always use your Affiliate referral link. Our social sharing shortcuts have your Affiliate referral link embedded in the posts.

Whenever a referral visits our site using your Affiliate referral link, we start (or restart) a 180-day countdown clock from that date. If that referral makes a purchase on their initial visit, or they visit our site again using your affiliate link during that 180-day time frame, their purchase is credited to you. If that same referral comes directly to our site without using your affiliate link during that 180-day time frame, because they are assigned to you for 180 days, we will still credit the sale to you.

However, if that same referral comes to our site after the 180-day countdown clock has expired without using your affiliate link, you do not get credit for their purchase. Also, if that referral visits our site using another Affiliate's referral link, they would be reassigned to that other Affiliate and that Affiliate would get credit for any purchase. Bottom line, you always want your referrals to use your Affiliate referral link and make a purchase within 180 days of their last visit!

As your referrals generate sales, you will accrue a commission of 15% of the sale. Accrued commissions are considered "earned" the last day of the month following the month of the sale. This is to allow time for any returns, refunds, etc. Total accrued "earned" commissions over $50 are paid to you the month following the month they are "earned" (less a small fee of approximately 3% paid to PayPal to manage the transaction). 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos or other promotional material with you through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share it.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, an Affiliate can invite others to become their downline Affiliate by sharing their network link. Any other Affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline Affiliate. If any downline Affiliate's referrals make a purchase from TrophySmack, the upline affiliate will also get a network commission (usually 2%-5% of the sale).

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to allow cookies on their device in order for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies, or clears their cookies, then we can't track them and can't pay Affiliate for their purchases.

"Cookie days" is on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the Affiliate's coupon. Within the cookie time frame, every order made by this customer at TrophySmack will automatically result in commissions to the Affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an Affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: sales@trophysmack.com

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've taken the time to read to the end of this important document and we wish you great success! You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send an email to sales@trophysmack.com for support.

Welcome to TrophySmack! 

Thanks again for joining our Affiliate program.
